name: Jon Ossoff
committees: Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs
stance: Treats advanced AI as a biosecurity and catastrophic-misuse risk, and as a child-safety risk, and uses his oversight perch to press the executive branch for safeguards.

statements.text: Opened an inquiry to the White House OSTP Director on bioterrorism and biosafety risks from AI, after AI-company researchers urged mandatory screening of synthetic nucleic-acid orders to keep AI from being misused to produce biological weapons.
Without adequate safeguards, including both screening and traceability processes, malicious actors could use advances in AI to develop potentially dangerous pathogens and biological weapons
Opened an investigation into the risks to children from AI.

review.note: added October 2026 from ossoff.senate.gov primary sources; quotes verified verbatim
